title: Request for volunteer intake and pantry agreements
not_questions: Our coordinators keep the volunteer roster in Salesforce.
We will not license Adobe Workfront under this award.
State all estimates in days and reserve one separately priced day for coordinator training.
never_in_text: Request for volunteer intake and pantry agreements

questions.text: Describe a short AEM Forms registration that a volunteer can complete on a shared pantry tablet without exposing the preceding volunteer's details.
Explain how AEM Forms would collect a guardian contact only for volunteers under eighteen and preserve the coordinator's review decision.
Describe how an AEM Forms submission would reach Salesforce after a network interruption at a pantry. Include a test for duplicate volunteer records.
Set out an AEM Forms accessibility rehearsal for volunteers who use a screen reader to choose a shift and correct a missing field.
Explain how Acrobat Sign would route a pantry agreement to the host and the trust when a coordinator serves both organizations.
Describe the Acrobat Sign evidence our coordinator should retain when a pantry changes address after an agreement is sent.
Propose an Acrobat Sign reminder schedule for seasonal hosts and show how staff would cancel an obsolete agreement before dispatching a replacement.
Describe how a completed Acrobat Sign agreement would be matched to the correct pantry in Salesforce when two sites share a legal name.
Identify the person who will teach our volunteer coordinators and provide their experience training staff at small community charities.
Provide two client references for projects with volunteer-run sites and state which parts of the work each reference can verify.
Quote an implementation fee that the board can approve separately from optional support. Identify the minimum support term.
State your firm's availability for the June board demonstration and name the substitute who could present if the lead is absent.
